question: Should RFC 0016 be accepted as OpenClaw's experimental contract for portable complete-agent Claw packages?
rationale: The proposal creates new cross-repository CLI, manifest, package, provenance, update, and removal contracts; document correctness cannot determine whether maintainers want to adopt that permanent product direction.

options.title: Accept the gated contract
options.body: Approve the complete-agent package model, transition the RFC through the repository acceptance process, and retain the experimental gate pending separate compatibility approval.

options.title: Continue draft incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC open as a draft while owners narrow or validate remaining cross-repository compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Decline the package model
options.body: Close the proposal if maintainers do not want a first-class portable-agent package lifecycle in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Accept the gated contract
recommendation.body: Approve the complete-agent package model, transition the RFC through the repository acceptance process, and retain the experimental gate pending separate compatibility approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed product-model review is the clearest item-specific ownership signal and is reflected throughout the current revision.
